author: Murphh
body:
I was on blue team and so was masterme5.  First, he tried to steal my enchantment table.  Then took my iron and food.  Then he poured lava on me.
I took this screenshot and hopefully it is enough to demonstrate his problem.  He's killed me before in other matches.  Thanks for reading.
